newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak major shares edge higher, SAX up 0.19 pts.
newsitem.headline: Slovak major shares edge higher, SAX up 0.19 pts.

text.p: Slovak major shares edged higher in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Tuesday, with gains to oil storage firm Nafta helping push the SAX index up 0.19 points to 209.23.
Nafta dominated trading on the BSE floor, closing up 30 crowns at 2,060 on a volume of 103,915 traded shares, but brokers said a gradual decrease in the issue may be expected.
"Only some hundred or two of Nafta shares were really traded today, the remainder were large blocks, likely agreed upon some time ago," said Patrik Granec of Slovenska Sporitelna.
The country's largest commercial bank VUB closed down 15 crowns at 1,835, while steel maker VSZ edged up one crown to 631.
Overall volume increased to 203,036 shares, from 198,645 shares traded on Monday, while turnover rose to 417.6 million crowns, from 157.2 million.
